title: Build /commander and /compute/p2p pages
goal: Two missing nav pages become real working tools. /commander (CryptArt Commander): in-browser terminal modeled on app/terminal/page.tsx allow-list pattern - 50ish local commands (help, coins, time, echo, theme, clear, date, calc, coin math), command history with up-arrow, safe unknown-command message; never executes arbitrary code. /compute/p2p (DonatePersonalSeconds): opt-in toggle, live Web Worker hash benchmark (hashes per second), donated-seconds counter persisted to localStorage, earned-coins estimate at fixed honest rate, stop button. Both SSR-safe with metadata.
